reports.name: 4BS
reports.stat: R2 FHB severity, spawn 2008 11.2%; R2 FHB severity, spawn 2011 1.6%; R2 FHB severity, spawn mean 3.4%; R2 FHB severity, spray 2009 4.3%; R2 FHB severity, spray 2010 10.8%; R2 FHB severity, spray mean 6.5%
reports.note: QTL for Fusarium head blight in the SHA3/CBRD x Naxos recombinant inbred line population after spawn and spray inoculation (Lu et al. 2012, Table 4). The label is the paper's own chromosome-arm designation. Resistance allele from Naxos. Associated with anther extrusion, plant height. R2 values are from the multiple regression models, per trait and year; the figure in the PVE field is the largest of them. Neither flanking marker could be placed physically, so no position is assigned. In-silico position on RefSeq v1.0: Interval from Rht-B1 (TraesCS4B02G043100, 30.86 Mb) to GWM368: GWM368 product 250 bp at 4B 59,605,155-59,605,405 bp (0/0 primer mismatches). GWM primer sequences from US patent 6720137 (IPK Gatersleben; Röder et al. 1998); in-silico PCR on RefSeq v1.0, Nov 2026 (ad70.py).
